submission.justification:
Absorber-F3 at 6 mm gave the lowest simulated energy resolution at 100 GeV of all candidates tested: 3.173%, versus 3.196% at 4 mm and 3.234% at 5 mm for F3, and 3.855% at best for F1 and 4.933% at best for F2 (all three materials were scanned from 2 to 10 mm). The 6 mm point is the minimum of the F3 scan. Mechanical support was reported compatible with all three absorbers. Caveats: the maintenance constraint could not be verified, because no maintenance mass limit was available (maintenance_mass_limit_available = 0 and maintenance_check_mass_limit_verified = 0). Radiation length, density and cost for all three materials were also unavailable, so the recommendation rests on resolution alone. The 6 mm F3 absorber's mass should be checked against the hands-on maintenance limit before it is adopted. The 2025 reference value at 5 mm (3.2%) is consistent with the simulated 3.234%.</justification>
